newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-New South Wales sees TAB float within year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-New South Wales sees TAB float within year.

text.p: New South Wales government Treasurer Michael Egan said on Tuesday he expected the state-owned betting agency, TAB, to be floated either late 1997 or early 1998.
TAB chairman Ross Cribb said: "Having regard to the impending privatisation, I expect this will be the last full year sales result for TAB in its current structure."
"The results show that the new TAB company will have a sound base from which to grow into additional gaming and wagering areas," Cribb said.

TAB said horse racing accounted for 74.93 percent of total turnover in 1996/97, followed by harness racing with 12.94 percent, greyhounds with 11.70 percent and sports bettings of 0.43 percent. Sports betting covers all other sports.
The NSW government announced in April it would sell its TAB betting agency.
TAB, formerly the Totalizator Agency Board of NSW, was established in 1964 to provide an off-course betting service on horse racing, harness racing and the greyhounds.
